description: Searches the public programmes of the GoodbyeMatrix index: more than 170 residency programmes in more than 80 countries (golden visa or residence by investment, digital nomad visa, independent means visa, active investor visa, skilled worker visa) and 20 citizenship by investment (second passport) programmes. Filters: country, region, programme type, maximum budget in USD, path to citizenship and dual citizenship. Returns a page of matching programmes (total, offset, limit, nextOffset) with id, name, country, type, minimum amount, physical presence, path to citizenship, dual citizenship and the programme page in German and English. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

citizenship_path.description: true: programmes with a path to citizenship; false: programmes without one.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example "PT") or name in English or German.

dual_citizenship_allowed.description: true: dual citizenship permitted; false: dual citizenship prohibited. Conditional cases match neither.

limit.description: Number of programmes per page (1 to 10, default 10).

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum minimum investment in USD; programmes without a known amount are not matched.

offset.description: Start position for the next page (nextOffset of the previous answer).

region.description: Region: europe, americas (including the Caribbean), asia, africa, middle_east or oceania.

type.description: Programme type: citizenship_by_investment, residence_by_investment (golden visa), digital_nomad, independent_means (retirees, passive income), active_investor (investor and entrepreneur visas) or skilled_work (skilled worker and talent visas).

name: search_programs

notice.description: General information, not legal, tax or immigration advice.

availability.description: Citizenship by investment only: cost_calculator, on_request, coming_soon or closed.

id.description: Programme id for get_program and compare_programs.

incomeRequirement.description: Residency only, where published: minimum income as on the programme page.

minInvestmentUsd.description: Minimum investment in USD where known (0 when no investment is required).

minimumAmount.description: Minimum investment as published on the programme page (currency as stated); for citizenship by investment the lowest starting amount in USD.

title: Search residency and citizenship programmes
